title: Preservation of well-formedness
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine whose query state, positive-answer state, and negative-answer state are pairwise distinct. Then the nondeterministic oracle machine obtained from $M$ also has pairwise distinct query, positive-answer, and negative-answer states.
hypotheses_covered: The query state differs from the positive-answer state
The query state differs from the negative-answer state
The positive-answer state differs from the negative-answer state
